subject.title: feat(goals): continue active session goals while idle

question: Should OpenClaw change core session goals from non-scheduling session state into an opt-in autonomous continuation runtime, or keep autonomous work under Task Flow, tasks, cron, and standing orders?
rationale: Current public docs intentionally separate goals from background or scheduled work, while this PR proposes a new core scheduler and configuration contract; tests cannot resolve that ownership decision.

options.title: Keep the current boundary
options.body: Retain goals as durable session guidance and implement unattended orchestration through Task Flow or another existing task owner.

options.title: Sponsor a core goal driver
options.body: Accept autonomous goal continuation as a core gateway capability and require full config, lifecycle, upgrade, safety, and live-proof implementation before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a reusable seam
options.body: Add only the missing generic lifecycle or task API needed for an external or task-owned continuation controller, without making goals schedule work directly.

recommendation.title: Keep the current boundary
recommendation.body: Retain goals as durable session guidance and implement unattended orchestration through Task Flow or another existing task owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The current goal product boundary and core implementation originate from their merged feature work.
